overall_summary: Analysis of the historical data reveals that relationship and family dynamic topics involving husband-wife dynamics ('पत्नी की ये बात', 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar') significantly outperform standard sad shayari or broader relationship generalities. The audience strongly engages with specific, realistic domestic scenarios rather than abstract heartbreak.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about husband-wife dynamics (or5gtaBpRVY with 1666 views, my5mP9feI7s with 1462 views) vastly outperformed all other single-topic categories.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on domestic relationship realities and subtle emotional friction between partners.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video YdWh4cDOE64 ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…') received only 6 views, showing low resonance for heavy, abstract poetry compared to situational emotional narratives.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavily poetic or overly dramatic abstract quotes; ground the content in everyday relatable interactions.
